title: Naidu opens Seed Access Road second phase, two steel bridges at Amaravati
description: The ₹1,519-crore road runs from Rayapudi through Venkatapalem, Penumaka and Undavalli, and its third phase will link the capital region to NH-16; a 110-metre bridge crosses the Buckingham Canal and a 280-metre span the Kondaveeti Vagu
